title: Timeless D.C. Spring
name: Xiaolu Xu
desc: In late March 2025, I wandered the Tidal Basin chasing the fleeting yearly beauty of the cherry blossoms. One ancient, gnarled tree stopped me—its twisted trunk and glowing blossoms framing the distant Washington Monument like a living proscenium arch. People drifted through that frame, but none moved me like the young mother gently pushing her stroller along the water’s edge. In her gentle, steady steps I saw pure devotion—the unspoken promise that brings her children true happiness. For one brief moment, she gave the timeless, yet ever-returning D.C. spring its deepest tenderness.

name: Catherine Wang
desc: Inspired by Frida Kahlo’s final painting, Viva La Vida – Watermelons, this moment captures my beloved little bird Hera joyfully perched on a watermelon, her gaze shining with the light of life. title: Frozen Symphony with Orange Notes 冰封交响曲

title: 《寂静的春天》
name: Catherine Wang
desc: 60年前，《寂静的春天》一书问世，作者Rachel Carson 在身患绝症，濒临瘫痪和失明的情况下为人类带来了第一部以环境保护为主题的书，成为世界环境保护的奠基之作。作品讲述了以DDT为代表的杀虫剂的广泛使用给人类生存环境造成的巨大危害，呼吁环境保护，否则人类的春天将永远寂静无声。全书既有严谨求实的科学理性，又有充满敬畏生命的人文关怀，成为近50年来最有影响力的书。60年后的今天，我拍摄下同名《寂静的春天》这幅摄影作品，致敬作者，致敬关爱，致敬生命。
